data.title: Chat watcher: resume() re-enters a stale advance-loop.json without evaluating the cap — one extra tick fires before settle() stops cap-hit

data.body: From the AS-95 cycle-2 review (qa-ruben, finding R1, low, non-blocking): a previous watcher generation's advance-loop.json at e.g. 30 ticks / 9 h is resumed by resume() and fires exactly one loop tick before settle() evaluates the cap and stops with reason cap-hit. Bounded (one tick), but the cap should be evaluated in resume() so a stale mirror past the cap stops without firing. Falsifier: a fixture mirror at ticks=24 resumed -> no fire, reason cap-hit; today it fires once. Do not start before AS-95 merges (same file, same lock semantics).
